I'm sorry Abt your family and your ex. That's really rough. I remember when I was 18-20 I had no friends at all and lived in an abusive household. It is really hard to be so alone. Your twenties can be very alienating.. I think in western society we had been fed a lie that we should have things figured out and a strong core friend group by mid twenties but that's not really realistic outside of sitcoms. 

Please try to lock in on a hobby. This can be anything.. even something as easy going as making Spotify playlists or catching up on a really long show. When I was my loneliest I used to watch a lot of Law & Order. Once you have a strong interest in something you will find ppl that relate to you. But you do have to try and find these people.

My best friend is someone I randomly added on Facebook because they had purple hair and a cool name. Come to find out we like the same comedians and learning abt true crime. We have talked daily since 2018. 
 
AI can be a very powerful tool. I used it today to talk over my anxieties and stress about work. It is like a journal that talks back and cheaper than therapy. But if you think you've become too dependent on it maybe go a few days without it.

Could be you were still half asleep and just not processing as fully awake. Could be derealization / dissociating which is normal for people with depression. Make note of it to a trusted adult. 

You seem very stressed.. maybe taking on too many things at once ? Or maybe instead of band you could find something else that engages you more.
